items.title: SD-106 validation: does generic bottleneck variance preservation reach PCA-32 parity at the consumer rung?
items.note: SD-106's pre-set acceptance measurement, per /implement-substrate Step 8. ACCEPTANCE TARGET (set by governance gov-20260911, NOT invented at build time): the observation->z_world latent reaches PCA-32 parity -- >= 0.85 held-out oracle-action agreement at the consumer rung (x734.PPOPolicyNet at PPO_TRUNK_HIDDEN) on a seed majority. The instrument is IMPORTED FROM V3-EXQ-1010, never re-implemented: capacity ladder, dataset recipe, standardiser, fit protocol, calibration anchor and thresholds all come from x1010/x1008/x1002, and x1010._fit_track_cell performs every cell. The one addition is a fourth track whose encoder trained with the SD-106 objective (preservation_weight=200.0, use_world_encoder_skip=True). 1010 itself is unmodified. | red-team (opus-5; fable requested first, refused by a provider spend limit, re-spawned once on the session model per Step 4.5): CONTESTED -> all 5 findings FIXED, 0 dismissed. F1 the anchor reachability certificate scored best-over-rungs while the gate measured the consumer rung, and the shipped `min` predicate was unmeetable against 1010's own anchor data (0.8578 < 0.85) -> references corrected and the predicate made a seed-majority rule; F2 a None `measured` made p0_readiness_gate raise an UNCAUGHT TypeError on the instrument-failure path, converting the designed substrate_not_ready_requeue self-route into an ERROR with no manifest -> guarded; F3 the C2 non-degeneracy witness (|delta| > 1e-9) could not fail and C1's own non-degeneracy was built on it -> C2 is now the mechanism fact (preservation head ran on every ON cell, no OFF cell); F4 1010's per-arm encoder-health gates were dropped -> encoder-trained and not-collapsed preconditions restored, unused ANCHOR_DEGRADE_TOL removed rather than advertised; F5 three minor (invented reference value, always-null offending_cell, unreachable branch) -> fixed. A sixth defect was found while fixing F4: the restored weight-delta gate read a non-existent key and would have failed forever. | Step 2.4 GOV-REUSE-1: the decisive readout is oracle-action agreement on an SD-106-ON latent; SD-106 landed 2026-09-11, so no recorded manifest on any substrate_hash can carry it -- not recoverable, run required. | Step 2.5c SCOPED USER EXCEPTION 2026-09-11: three open `corrupting` substrate entries overlap modules any all-ON agent driver exercises -- mode-governance-engagement (ree_core/agent.py, utils/config.py, salience_coordinator.py), contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy (e1_deep.py::ContextMemory.write) and SD-e1-rollout-consistency-training (e1_deep.py::forward, ::predict_long_horizon). Granted because V3-EXQ-1010, the run governance pre-set as this acceptance measurement, ALREADY EXECUTED under these identical three defects, and this comparison is PAIRED (ON vs OFF vs anchor vs raw, all under the same defects). Recorded so the manifest and any later autopsy see the limitation. | PROMOTES NOTHING on its own; experiment_purpose=diagnostic. A null means the objective at preservation_weight=200.0 does not recover oracle-relevant content on this rung -- NOT that preservation is the wrong lever -> /failure-autopsy, not an automatic re-queue at another weight.

items.title: MECH-349 CandidateRuleField churn/retirement leg: is churn selective, or the 666c treadmill?
items.note: PROVENANCE CORRECTION (note amended after reading the sibling session's close notes): there is NO V3-EXQ-1024 RUN. That id was RESERVED on 2026-09-11 for MECH-349's owed GFLAG-0198 validation and RELEASED WITHOUT EVER BEING QUEUED -- four successive designs were each killed by adversarial design review, no manifest exists, nothing reached origin or the coordinator DB, and the driver was retired to ree-v3/experiments/_scratch/mech349_crf_harness_NOT_QUEUEABLE.py. The structural fact this leg rests on (retirement unreachable at crf_maintenance_decay=0.0) is recorded in GFLAG-0265 and is RE-MEASURED HERE from scratch by ARM_FROZEN, not taken on trust. Earlier phrasing cited 1024 as a landed sibling run; that was wrong and is fixed here and in the script docstring. | OPEN GOVERNANCE QUESTION THIS RUN DOES NOT SETTLE: GFLAG-0268 (contested_disposition, OPEN, raised 2026-09-11T17:37Z) asks whether MECH-349 is an EMPIRICAL claim at all -- its CREATE-face clauses (i)/(ii) are argued to restate _maybe_mint rather than predict anything it could fail to do. This leg targets FALSIFYING(3), the CHURN face, which that argument does not reach: whether a still-recurring regularity keeps its slot is a dynamical property of credit()'s leak-vs-refresh balance, demonstrably falsifiable here (the positive control fails C1 with 94-95 persistent re-mints). HONEST CAVEAT: what C1 establishes is that the selective-forgetting basin CONTAINS the operating point -- a parameter fact, the residue GFLAG-0268 says is all that remains testable. Read as evidence about the churn face only; the sibling redesign chip chip-20260911-mech349-validation-redesign is gated on GFLAG-0268. | MECH-349 FALSIFYING(3), the churn/retirement leg V3-EXQ-1024 explicitly could NOT test: under the stack the claim names (mature_pool_dynamics + availability_maintenance, maintenance_decay=0.0) retirement is STRUCTURALLY UNREACHABLE, so crf_n_retired_total is pinned at 0 and the 666c signature cannot occur whatever the mechanism does. 1024 recorded that as a structural fact; GFLAG-0265 recorded the residual. This is that residual, and the option-C properly-tagged run MECH-349 evidence_quality_note owes. | LEVER, measured 2026-09-11: the remedy MECH-349 what_would_answer (c) names first -- maintenance_floor below mature_retire_floor -- is INERT on its own (_maybe_mint sets init_avail = max(tolerance_floor, maintenance_floor), so a rule still mints at 0.30 vs the 0.05 retire floor; retired=0 unchanged). Dropping tolerance_floor too DOES retire (93/100) but degenerately, every rule minting below the floor and dying at once, which MANUFACTURES the 666c signature instead of testing for it -- rejected. Lever used is crf_maintenance_decay, the only knob in credit() reaching a rule that carries no eligibility. Single-axis arms 0.00 anchor / 0.02 / 0.10 scored / 0.35 positive control; selective plateau measured 0.01-0.28, treadmill from 0.30, so the scored arms are interior to a 28x basin. | SCOPE CORRECTION recorded, not scored: MECH-349 non-degeneracy (b) asks retired/minted <= 0.25, but in an ecology containing extinct regularities that ratio is fixed by the ecology -- a perfectly SELECTIVE creator scores 0.50 and would FAIL the bar for behaving correctly. Criteria are per-regime-class instead. | Step 2.4 GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout is crf_n_retired_total / persistent-vs-extinct churn at a retirement-reachable operating point. Only 4 manifests carry crf_n_retired_total (666, 666a, 666b, 666c), all June 2026 on four distinct substrate_hashes and all PRE-SD-078, while FALSIFYING(3) asks specifically about the SD-078-CENTERED key -- not recoverable, run required. | Step 2.5b re-derive brake: 0 counted autopsies on MECH-349, not braked. Step 2.5c: no open corrupting substrate_queue entry overlaps ree_core/policy/candidate_rule_field.py (the driver imports only that module + torch). | red-team (opus-5; fable requested first, refused by a provider spend limit, re-spawned once on the session model per Step 4.5): CONTESTED -> all findings FIXED, none dismissed. F1 C2 was ANALYTICALLY INERT, implied by (gate AND C1) since the gate forced every scored cell to retire >=1 while C1 forced retired_persistent==0; F2 the readiness gate EVICTED an arm on C2 own predicate before C2 ran, so a dose retiring nothing was dropped rather than failing -- narrowing always toward PASS, and it FIRED in the smoke; fixed together by gating reachability on the POSITIVE CONTROL only, which makes the crf_retirement_not_exercised branch reachable (the same smoke now correctly reports it). F3 non_degenerate could never be False because the anchor arm is unconditionally green -> gated on a scored arm, with the full per-arm precondition list emitted when none is. F5 MECH-349 (c) was half-implemented and its missing conjunct failed on every cell (all 12 mints in ticks 24-35 of 840) -> ecology now staggers persistent-regime onsets and the conjunct is gated; 2 late mints per arm/seed after the fix. F6 minor: anchor could not fail, NaN reached the manifest, realized-n seed denominator -> all fixed. | SEPARATELY, found pre-review and independently confirmed by it: churn bookkeeping by set-difference on slot indices undercounted 30-47% because credit() retires before _maybe_mint() and _free_slot_index() reuses the freed slot in the SAME step, and id() cannot detect it (CPython address reuse) -> rules keyed (slot, minted_step) with hard reconciliation and partition asserts. | SEEDS ARE A REPRODUCIBILITY GATE, NOT POWER: regime directions are seed-independent so DVs are near-deterministic; the discrimination is BETWEEN ARMS (0 vs 6 vs 165 retirements). The dose-response was pre-measured at design time, so a supports here is a properly-tagged filing, not an independent discriminating test. | MECH-350/351/352 NOT tagged; crf_max_pairwise_rule_dist is a structural identity here and is recorded for continuity only.
